title: GetHigh.EXE
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#799, 2026-10-29), the Epic copy, Apple M1, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, D3DMetal with AVX advertised, rated 2 of 5 after 2 minutes: the game opens on its settings screen at 60 fps and its arrow button did not start anything. A DualSense did not work, an XInput pad did. Not verified by the maintainer. Follow-up the same day: Esc closes the settings and starts the game (it has no title menu), the sound stutters badly, and a DualSense still gets no input.
notes: Plays on an M1 (Epic) at 60 fps. It opens on its settings screen, and Esc starts the game. The sound stutters badly.

knownIssues.symptom: Opens on its settings screen with no title menu
The sound stutters badly (M1, default engine)
knownIssues.fix: none known. Untested: the Wine 11 engine, whose sound held up better under load in our tests
